'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present)|Central African Republic Civil War]]
**A coalition of rebel groups briefly seize the city of [[Bambari]] from the [[Central African Republic]] [[government of the Central African Republic|government]] and [[United Nations]] before being driven off in a UN [[counter-offensive]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20201223-un-retakes-rebel-held-town-in-run-up-to-election-in-central-african-republic (France 24)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[December 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Yousuf Rasheed, [[CEO]] of the Free and Fair Election Forum of [[Afghanistan]], is killed by unknown gunmen in [[Kabul]]. His driver is also shot and later died of his wounds. It is the latest [[targeted killing]] of a prominent Afghan figure. [https://tolonews.com/index.php/afghanistan-168707 (TOLO News)]
*[[Metekel conflict]]
**[[Metekel massacre]]
***More than 100 people are killed and at least 30 others wounded in a [[massacre]] in [[Metekel]], [[Benishangul-Gumuz]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55428531 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Shortages related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Lufthansa]] ships 80 tonnes of fresh food to the [[United Kingdom]] to prevent shortages amid fears that the lifting of the [[France|French]] [[blockade]] of the [[France–UK border]] will not prevent shortages in some supermarkets. The airline says "additional special cargo flights" are planned to meet demand. Thousands of trucks remain outside of [[Dover]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/23/lufthansa-fly-fresh-food-uk-shortage-fears-fruit-vegetables-border-french-blockade (''The Guardian'')] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
******[[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] orders people traveling from the [[United Kingdom]] to [[quarantine]] or face fines due to the discovery of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nyc-mayor-bill-deblasio-quarantine-uk-travelers-1000-fine-2020-12-23/ (CBS News)]
*****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] says that 1 million [[Americans]] have received the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccines]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/23/cdc-more-than-1-million-americans-got-covid-shots-450303 (Politico)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[Health Canada]] approves the [[Moderna]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] and expects that up to 168,000 doses will arrive in [[Canada]] by the end of the year. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/canada-approves-moderna-vaccine-1.5852848 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Karnataka]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Karnataka]] imposes a night [[curfew]] from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]] until January 2 due to fears of a mutant version of [[SARS-CoV-2]] that was found in the United Kingdom. It becomes the second [[Indian state]] to do so after [[Maharashtra]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/karnataka-imposes-night-curfew-from-10-pm-to-6-am-until-january-2-amid-covid-19-2342458 (NDTV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****The number of recovered patients in [[Indonesia]] increases by a record 5,981 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recovered patients to 558,703. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5307115/pecah-rekor-lagi-ini-sebaran-5981-pasien-corona-sembuh-di-ri-23-desember (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Japan]] bans the entry of non-Japanese citizens from the United Kingdom beginning tomorrow, following the emergence of a more infectious strain of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/japan-to-ban-entry-of-non-japanese-from-uk-due-to-coronavirus-mutation (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] discovers a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 named A701B in [[Sabah]]. It has been deemed to be more infectious. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2020/12/23/new-covid-19-strain-identified-in-sabah-says-health-ministry (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] approves the suspension of flights from the [[Philippines]] to the United Kingdom from tomorrow at 12:01 a.m. local time until December 31 due to concerns about the new strain of [[SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/12/23/20/philippines-suspends-flights-from-uk-dec-24-31-over-new-covid-19-strain (ABS-CBN News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Qatar]]
****[[Qatar]] begins administering the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[vaccine]] [[tozinameran]] to its citizens at designated health centers in the country. Those aged over 70, adults with chronic health conditions and [[healthcare personnel]] are to be prioritised for the [[vaccine]]. [https://www.thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/12/2020/Qatar-begins-administering-Covid-19-vaccine (''The Peninsula Qatar'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Singapore]] reports the first case of a mutated variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the United Kingdom when 17-year-old girl who had studied in the United Kingdom tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/singapore-confirms-1-imported-patient-with-potentially-more-contagious-covid-19-strain (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[South Korea]] suspends flights to and from the United Kingdom until December 31 over concerns about the new strain of SARS-CoV-2. [http://world.kbs.co.kr/service/news_view.htm?lang=e&Seq_Code=158465 (KBS World)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 39,237 new cases in the past 24 hours. In addition, the country also reports 744 deaths, the highest single-day total since April 29. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-12-23/uk-records-744-new-covid-deaths-the-highest-since-april-29 (ITV)]
****[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] announces a ban on travel from [[South Africa]] due to the discovery of [[501.V2 Variant|a mutated variant]] of SARS-CoV-2 in South Africa. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/transport/travel-ban-on-south-africa-arrivals-over-another-new-coronavirus-strain-b466001.html (''Business Standard'')]
****Hancock also announces that more locations in [[England]] will be placed in Tier 4 restrictions beginning on [[Boxing Day]], including [[Oxfordshire]], [[West Sussex]], and the remainder of [[East Sussex]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/23/millions-more-face-tier-4-covid-restrictions-in-england-from-boxing-day (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Government of the Czech Republic|government]] announces that the [[Czech Republic]] will be moving to the highest level of PES measures beginning on December 27. This means that all non-essential shops will be closed and a curfew between 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time on Sunday will be enforced. There will also be no exceptions on [[New Year's Eve]]. [https://www.expats.cz/czech-news/article/breaking-czech-republic-to-enter-highest-level-of-anti-covid-measures-from-friday (Expats.cz)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 962 deaths in the past 24 hours, according to data from the [[Robert Koch Institute]], bringing the nationwide death toll to 27,968. [https://www.dpa-international.com/topic/fresh-record-germany-registers-962-coronavirus-deaths-24-urn%3Anewsml%3Adpa.com%3A20090101%3A201223-99-793212 (dpa International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses 70,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://m.huffingtonpost.it/entry/covid-italia-553-morti-superata-quota-70mila-tasso-positivita-all83_it_5fe369e3c5b6ff74797f47c6 (''Huffington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****[[Switzerland]] begins a mass vaccination campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] using the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] vaccine [[tozinameran]]. A ninety-year-old woman in [[Lucerne]] is the first Swiss citizen to receive the vaccine. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-swiss-vaccine/ninety-year-old-woman-first-in-switzerland-to-get-covid-19-shot-idUKKBN28X1DX?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–United States relations]], [[International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] imposes additional sanctions against [[Belarusians|Belarusian]] officials and four offices for human rights abuses that occurred during [[2020 Belarusian protests|protests]] against [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/531468-trump-imposes-fresh-sanctions-on-belarus-over-electoral-fraud-human (''The Hill'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Saint-Just shooting]]
**Three [[law enforcement in France|police]] officers are killed and a fourth wounded after they responded to a [[domestic violence]] incident in [[Saint-Just, Puy-de-Dôme]], [[France]]. The gunman, who [[arson|set his house on fire]], is later found dead. The gunman's partner was rescued. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55421761 (BBC News)]
*[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Stranded lorry drivers clash with police in [[Kent]], England, amid frustrations over ongoing delays at the border with France. At least one person has been arrested for obstructing a highway, according to the [[Kent Police|police]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/23/lorry-drivers-clash-police-tensions-rise-over-queues-kent (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Elections in Israel]]
**[[23rd Knesset|Parliament]] is dissolved as the deadline to approve the 2020 state budget expires without an agreement, [[2021 Israeli legislative election|requiring elections within 90 days]], for the fourth time in less than two years. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-calls-4th-election-in-2-years-as-netanyahu-gantz-coalition-collapses/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] [[List of people granted executive clemency in the first presidency of Donald Trump|pardons]] former [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] manager [[Paul Manafort]], former adviser [[Roger Stone]], and [[real estate developer]] [[Charles Kushner]]. Manafort was convicted of tax fraud and obstructing an investigation; Stone of lying to Congress; Kushner of tax evasion, campaign finance offences and witness tampering. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-55433522 (BBC News)]
*[[Prime Minister of Moldova|Moldovan Prime Minister]] [[Ion Chicu]] announces that he will [[resign]] ahead of [[President of Moldova|President-elect]] [[Maia Sandu]]'s inauguration. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/23/moldovas-pro-russian-prime-minister-resigns-after-protests (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A ~{{convert|8|m|ft}} asteroid falls over [[Nangqên County|Nangqên]], in western [[China]] on the [[Qinghai]]-[[Tibet]] border. This was the largest asteroid to hit Earth since the [[Kamchatka meteor]] in 2018, and the largest to fall over land since the [[Chelyabinsk meteor]] in 2013. [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-9082441/Huge-ball-fire-falls-sky-crashes-Chinese-town.html (''Daily Mail'')] [https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/ (JPL Center for NEO Studies)]
